title: Speed, stated plainly
body: Time per frame on a dense video (M5 Pro), finding and tracking together:
2.9 s → 1.7 s: image encoder and memory attention moved to half-precision Core ML
1.7 s → 1.0 s: the encoder now works one frame ahead, and two more parts moved to Core ML
Accuracy held at each step: HOTA 0.570 before, 0.5695 now, over 1,500 unseen frames
Not real time yet. The existing Mac port of SAM 3.1 is faster, but it only tracks: it can't take a text prompt or find new cells
